Each project page describes the scientific problem, my specific role, methods, and current status. Work I led is distinguished from collaborative or ongoing (unpublished) work; confidential or collaborator-owned results are generalized or omitted.

::: {.placeholder-note}
**To add a new project:** copy `projects/_template.qmd`, rename it, fill in the YAML front matter (`title`, `categories`, `date`, `image`) and the body sections, then add it to this folder — it will appear here automatically.
:::
